svg.title: BellHop, an isometric sketch of the robot
svg.desc: Pencil-style isometric drawing on a cream sketchbook page: a four-wheeled robot with solid tires and yellow hubs, a taped display showing smiling crescent eyes, a thin white nurse cap with a red cross centered above the screen, an upright speaker behind the display with a PS2 receiver on top, blue pan and tilt servos, an ultrasonic sensor face with a green-edged Pi camera mouth and red dot, a cardboard brace and a blue lanyard.

text.style: font-family:var(--font-voice);font-style:italic;fill:#6b6358;fill:rgb(107, 99, 88);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:anthropic-serif, ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif, ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:400;font-style:italic;text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:auto
